Expected safe result: No cgroup write; restart cannot enable control.

Scenario: Stale, missing, malformed or out-of-range sample/proposal
Expected safe result: LEAVE/deny with reason; no OS write; no silent zero-fill.

Scenario: Unauthenticated Unix peer or malformed IPC
Expected safe result: SO_PEERCRED/payload validation rejects request; audit denial.

Scenario: PID reused or process start time changes

Expected safe result: No such route; dashboard has no actuator socket/write permission.

Scenario: Prior value changed by host owner before rollback
Expected safe result: Do not overwrite unowned value; fail closed and audit.
Block new writes; safe restore only for verified AIOS-owned target.

Scenario: Rollback target disappears or becomes uncertain
Expected safe result: No guessed target; degraded fallback; audit outcome.

Scenario: SQLite/WAL cap or disk space reached
Expected safe result: Expose degraded data state; stale/incomplete evidence cannot authorize control.

Scenario: Audit chain altered, reordered, or truncated
Expected safe result: Integrity check detects break; automated writes disabled pending review.
Explicit unavailable/denied status; no escalation; stay observe-only.

Scenario: Quota delays inference/watchdog or harms foreground
Expected safe result: Fail resource gate; retain OBSERVE_ONLY/revert profile.
Restart preserves explicit safe mode; no hidden enablement.
